en.t: My feet could no longer take a step forward.

units.source_text: 想烦了，最后连自己也闲不清楚究竟我是为了焚毁金阁才抛弃贞操，

en.t: After worrying over it, in the end even I myself could no longer tell whether I had abandoned my chastity in order to burn down the Golden Pavilion,

units.source_text: 还是为了失去贞操才要把金阁焚毁？

en.t: or whether I wanted to burn down the Golden Pavilion in order to lose my chastity.

units.source_text: 这时，心里毫无意义地泛起"天步艰难"这个高贵的词组，

en.t: At that moment, the noble phrase "the heavenly path is hard" rose meaninglessly in my mind,

units.source_text: 我念叨着"天步艰难。天步艰难"，一边向前走去。

en.t: and, murmuring "the heavenly path is hard, the heavenly path is hard," I walked on ahead.
